How to wash shoes? How to wash shoes in the washing machine?
settings.content:
We don’t recommend washing Ahinsa shoes in the washing machine. Higher temperature and spin speeds don’t agree with them; they could cause the glue to come apart or the material to be damaged. With other manufacturers, look for the maker’s instructions, but in general washing shoes in the washing machine isn’t recommended.

If you’ve chosen shoes made from CF+ microfiber, they don’t even need washing – just wipe them with a damp cloth. 

How to wash shoes made of suede, hemp, canvas and other materials?

Wash shoes gently by hand so they last as long as possible. These tips have worked well for us when washing shoes and are also suitable for sensitive natural materials.

  • Clean gently with soapy water.
  • Try the ecological cleaning kit.

If the shoes smell, dry them, let them air out and use a shoe freshener.

Tip: Read the detailed recommendations on the page How to care for your shoes. We’ll advise you on odor in the article 7 + 5 proven tips for getting rid of shoe odor.

settings.title: What temperature to wash shoes?
settings.content:
Ahinsa shoes don’t like the washing machine. That’s why you should never wash them in the washing machine and don’t dry them on a radiator. The same warning applies to most shoe brands. In the washing machine and on a radiator the glue that joins the individual parts of the shoe can come apart.

You can wash, for example, laces or shoe insoles in the washing machine, but whole shoes don’t belong in it. If you’re washing laces, we recommend putting them in a laundry bag or mesh wash bag.

How to wash shoes when they can’t go in the washing machine?

If you’ve chosen shoes made from CF+ microfiber, they don’t even need washing. Just wipe them with a damp cloth. For shoes made from other materials such as hemp, canvas or denim, we recommend:

  • Clean gently with soapy water.
  • Try the ecological cleaning kit.
  • If the shoes smell, dry them, let them air out and use a shoe freshener.

Tip: Read the detailed recommendations on the page How to care for your shoes. We’ll advise you on odor in the article 7 + 5 proven tips for getting rid of shoe odor.

settings.title: How to clean shoes?
settings.content:
We make most Ahinsa shoe models from CF+ microfiber. Dirt stays on its surface, so when it gets dirty you just need to wipe it with a damp cloth. Cleaning is therefore very, very simple.

Never wash the shoes in the washing machine and don’t dry them on a radiator. High temperatures and spin speeds don’t agree with them; they could damage the material and unglue the shoes. So always clean the shoes gently by hand.

How to clean shoes made from other materials?

Other materials (suede, canvas, hemp and more) can be more sensitive to care. That’s why we recommend washing them by hand, never scrubbing. Here are tips that have worked well for us and will also work with other shoe brands:

  • Clean gently with soapy water.
  • Try the ecological cleaning kit.
  • If the shoes smell, dry them, let them air out and use a shoe freshener.

Tip: Read the detailed recommendations on the page How to care for your shoes. We’ll advise you on odor in the article 7 + 5 proven tips for getting rid of shoe odor.

settings.title: How to remove odor from shoes?
settings.content:
Odor is caused by bacteria that multiply in moisture. So first let the shoes dry thoroughly and air out. In winter you can help yourself with newspaper. But be careful: never dry shoes on a radiator, they could come unglued. We also don’t recommend washing them in the washing machine; hot water and high spin speeds harm them.

For acute odor, a shoe freshener that eliminates the smell will help. Or try odor absorbers such as cedar wood.

How to get rid of shoe odor once and for all?

You want to get rid of the odor forever, don’t you? If so, deal with the cause. Shoes don’t stink on their own – the odor is created by bacteria that thrive in a damp, enclosed environment. 

Make sure you have enough room in your shoes. Cramped feet sweat more. Wear only shoes made from breathable materials that wick moisture out. And put on socks made from natural materials such as bamboo.

Tip: You’ll find more advice in the article 7 + 5 proven tips for getting rid of shoe odor.

settings.title: How to clean the inside of barefoot shoes?
settings.content:
Ahinsa barefoot shoes don’t like the washing machine, so always clean them by hand and dry them slowly in the air. Never dry them on a radiator. You can clean the inside of the shoe with soapy water or an ecological cleaner. This cleaning kit has worked well for us. 

We recommend cleaning the inside of the shoes gently with circular movements. A cloth, a sponge or a soft cleaning brush will work well.

Cleaning shoes because of odor? Here are our tips

Odor is caused by bacteria that multiply in moisture. So first let the shoes dry thoroughly and air out. In winter you can help yourself with newspaper. But be careful: never dry shoes on a radiator, they could come unglued. We also don’t recommend washing them in the washing machine; hot water and high spin speeds harm them.

For acute odor, a shoe freshener that eliminates the smell will help. Or try odor absorbers such as cedar wood.

Tip: You’ll find more advice in the article 7 + 5 proven tips for getting rid of shoe odor.

settings.title: How to soften a shoe heel?
settings.content:
You don’t need to soften Ahinsa shoes. We make them primarily from CF+ microfiber, which molds to the foot. Shoes made from natural materials such as hemp or linen can be firmer. With those, you just need to wait – over time they will mold to your foot and soften.

If your heel still pinches, get in touch. We’ll look into it.

When the heel rubs, it points to a problem.

The heel of healthy shoes that fit you shouldn’t rub. It may take a while for firmer leather shoes, for example, to ease. But a heel shouldn’t pinch for long, and it certainly shouldn’t rub and cause blisters and sores.

If your shoes rub, you’ve probably chosen the wrong size or model. When choosing, make sure you have enough room in the shoe for free movement. The shoe shouldn’t have a reinforced heel counter and should follow the movement of the foot. That’s why Ahinsa shoes don’t have a heel counter either, and they’ll fit you the first time you put them on.

settings.title: How to measure shoe size? How to measure a shoe insole?
settings.content:
The insole in Ahinsa shoes (and in many other shoes) is usually glued in so it doesn’t shift in the shoe. That’s why you can’t take it out and measure it. Finding out its length is easy, though. Look at the shoe size and find it in our size charts.

We don’t recommend choosing shoe size according to old shoes. How else to do it?

If you want to find out the insole size, take it out of the shoe and measure its longest dimension. From the size charts you’ll find out which size the insole length corresponds to.

We don’t recommend choosing the size of new shoes according to this information, though, because it’s very imprecise. Better to measure your feet carefully so you can be sure the shoes will really fit. How to do it?

Need to measure your foot and choose a size? Try it like this:

  1. Stand with your heel right against the wall.
  2. Place a box (or another object with a straight edge) in front of your toes so that it touches the longest toe.
  3. Weight the foot.
  4. Hold the box and lift your foot so that the box doesn’t move.
  5. Measure the distance from the box to the edge of the paper. Careful: measure perpendicular to the short side of the paper!

When choosing a size, don’t forget to add the extra room – that’s about 0.5 cm of free space in front of the toes, thanks to which the foot can stretch and contract naturally.

Tip: You’ll find a detailed guide on the page How to choose a size.

settings.title: How to choose shoe size?
settings.content:
Never choose only according to the size you’re used to. Every manufacturer numbers shoes a little differently, so the shoes may not fit you. We recommend first carefully measuring the length of your foot. We describe how on the page How to choose the right size.

How to measure foot length correctly and choose a size?

You’ll need a box or another object with a straight edge and a long ruler. The procedure is simple:

  1. Stand with your heel right against the wall.
  2. Place a box (or another object with a straight edge) in front of your toes so that it touches the longest toe.
  3. Weight the foot.
  4. Hold the box and lift your foot so that the box doesn’t move.
  5. Measure the distance from the box to the edge of the paper. Careful: measure perpendicular to the short side of the paper!

Add the extra room – that’s about 0.5 cm of free space in front of the toes, thanks to which the foot can stretch and contract naturally.

Then look at the size chart for the shoe model you’ve chosen. According to the length of your foot plus the extra room you’ll easily choose the size. If you’re hesitating between two sizes, choose the larger one. 

Tip: If the shoes don’t fit, we’ll exchange them lightning-fast and pay the postage. How does it work?

settings.title: How to stretch sports shoes?
settings.content:
You don’t need to stretch Ahinsa sports shoes. We make them from materials that are pliable and adapt to you and to your walking and running style. If your Ahinsa shoes pinch, you may have chosen the wrong size. Get in touch and we’ll be happy to help you choose.

Sports shoes made of stiff leather may need stretching. With those it usually just takes wearing them for a while; over time they soften and adapt. 

When a shoe pinches, it points to a problem.

Healthy sports shoes that fit you shouldn’t rub. It may take a while for firmer leather shoes, for example, to ease. But they shouldn’t pinch for long, and they certainly shouldn’t rub and cause blisters and sores.

If your shoes rub, you’ve probably chosen the wrong size or model. When choosing, make sure you have enough room in the shoe for free movement. A wide toe box and adaptive materials that follow the movement of your foot are key. 

Tip: The article How to choose running shoes? Cushioning hurts you, studies say will help you choose healthy sports shoes.

settings.title: What are wide-toe-box shoes for?
settings.content:
We’re glad you’re asking. We stand by the wide toe box. When you look at the human foot, you’ll see that it isn’t pointed. That means the shape of ordinary shoes doesn’t correspond to what our foot needs. 

That’s why at Ahinsa shoes we make shoes with a wide toe box. So the toes aren’t squeezed and can function naturally. When you give the toes freedom, you prevent bunions, heel spur and other problems.

Tip: Download the free e-book Happy Feet: The most common foot problems and exercises for them.

Why is a wide toe box so important?

For healthy walking, the toes are very important. We push off from them and at the same time we use them to cushion our landings. The toes also activate the arch, which takes care of cushioning the step, and thanks to them we gain balance.

And it’s the toes that we squeeze in ordinary shoes into an unnatural point. The results don’t take long to show. The toes can’t move, so we lose the ability to use them. We look for other, unnatural ways of walking. Because of inactive toes the muscles of the sole also weaken and the arch falls. 

A wide toe box is therefore essential for the proper functioning of the foot. In it the toes have enough room to fulfill their function. And you walk healthily and naturally.

settings.title: How can you tell shoes are too small?
settings.content:
If you’re asking yourself this question, you can probably already feel that your shoes are restricting you in some way. That’s always a bad sign. Healthy shoes don’t restrict you or affect your gait. On the contrary, they give you enough space and follow your movement. When shoes fit you well, you barely notice them.

So how do I recognize shoes that are too small?

They don’t necessarily have to rub or give you blisters. You can already recognize small shoes by these signs:

  • They pinch.
  • You don’t have free space in front of your toes.
  • They slip off.
  • When you walk, your toes hit the toe box.

When choosing shoes, always measure your feet carefully first. Choose according to the manufacturer’s size charts, not according to the size you’re used to. We recommend always adding about 0.5 cm extra to the length of your foot – the so-called extra room. That’s the free space in front of the toes that lets the foot stretch and contract naturally as you walk.

Do your Ahinsa shoes not fit, and you haven’t taken them outside yet? Write to us and we’ll send you a new pair lightning-fast and pay the postage.

settings.title: How should shoes fit?
settings.content:
In healthy, well-fitting shoes you should almost not notice them. They shouldn’t pinch you or slop around on your foot. If the first time you put them on you think they pinch or rub a little, but they’ll surely ease, pay attention. The shoes may not ease, and then they’d only torment you.

If you’ve just bought the shoes and they’ve arrived at home, try them on indoors first. If you find they don’t fit, you can return them or exchange them for a different size free of charge.

7 signs that your shoes fit well

Try walking around the room in the shoes. Notice how you feel in them. You should have the feeling that:

  1. The shoe sits naturally on the foot.
  2. Nothing slops around anywhere.
  3. Your toes don’t hit the toe box.
  4. Your toes have enough room to move.
  5. In front of the toes there remains about 0.5 cm of free space at rest.
  6. The shoe doesn’t pinch the instep.
  7. The shoe doesn’t fall off the foot or slip off.

Do your Ahinsa shoes not fit, and you haven’t taken them outside yet? Write to us and we’ll send you a new pair lightning-fast and pay the postage.

settings.title: What’s the difference between a men’s and a women’s shoe?
settings.content:
When it comes to healthy anatomical shoes, there’s no difference. A man’s foot and a woman’s foot look and function the same, so they don’t need a different cut. The difference will therefore only be aesthetic. At Ahinsa shoes we divide shoes into men’s and women’s only to make choosing easier for you. But you can buy shoes from either category.

The men’s/women’s split isn’t important. The shape of the foot matters more

More important than the split into men’s and women’s shoes is the shape of your foot. For wider feet we’ve created the xWide line, in which nothing pinches you at last and the foot functions naturally. If, on the other hand, most shoes feel wide on you, you probably have a narrow foot and our extra-narrow models will fit you.

Also pay attention to instep height. If shoes often pinch you on the instep, you have a higher instep. Our lace-up models, which you can loosen over the instep, will fit you best.

Tip: Have a look at the page How to choose the right size.

settings.title: How big should winter shoes be?
settings.content:
The same applies to healthy winter shoes as to the others: in front of your toes you should have about 0.5 cm of free space, the so-called extra room. Thanks to it the foot can function naturally. So first measure your foot and then choose the size that corresponds to the length of your foot plus the extra room.

Why the extra room? Because in healthy shoes your foot naturally contracts and stretches. With the extra room it has space for that and can function naturally. Without it the foot is as if in a cast. It doesn’t move, circulation is reduced, and it soon gets cold.

Two pairs of socks aren’t a good idea

We don’t recommend two pairs of socks or extra-thick socks in winter shoes. They can constrict the feet and restrict their movement. They slow blood circulation and can even make the foot colder. 

If you’re someone who always feels cold, we recommend adding a winter insole or these winter socks.

Tip: Read the article How to choose winter shoes? Note: You don’t need two pairs of socks.

settings.title: How to stretch shoes? How to stretch shoes in width?
settings.content:
You don’t need to stretch Ahinsa shoes. We make them from materials that are pliable and adapt to you and to your walking style. Shoes made from natural materials such as hemp or linen can be firmer. With those, you just need to wait – over time they will mold to your foot and soften.

If the shoes pinch, you may have chosen the wrong size. Get in touch and we’ll be happy to help you choose.

Tip: Do most shoes pinch you? You may simply have a wide foot and need extra-wide shoes. For cases like that we’ve created the xWide line. Put it on and you’ll fall in love: your foot will experience for the first time what it’s like to have as much room as it needs for healthy walking.

When a shoe pinches, it points to a problem.

Healthy shoes that fit you shouldn’t rub. It may take a while for firmer leather shoes, for example, to ease. But they shouldn’t pinch for long, and they certainly shouldn’t rub and cause blisters and sores.

If your shoes rub, you’ve probably chosen the wrong size or model. When choosing, make sure you have enough room in the shoe for free movement. A wide toe box and adaptive materials that follow the movement of your foot are key. 

Tip: The article No more blisters! How to choose healthy shoes? will help you choose healthy shoes.

settings.title: What are the best shoes for walking?
settings.content:
The best shoes are those that respect the shape and function of your foot. They shouldn’t change or restrict your movement in any way. Walking is natural and healthy only when we can move as freely as when barefoot.

That’s why watch out for everything that affects your gait: a thick sole, a heel, stiff materials, a narrow toe box, or a generally non-anatomical shoe shape. 

5 signs that you’re wearing healthy shoes

So how do you recognize the best shoes for walking?

  1. A wide toe box gives the toes room.
  2. Flexible materials adapt to the foot.
  3. A flexible sole follows your movement.
  4. A zero heel ensures that the foot and the whole body don’t tilt.
  5. The shoes don’t pinch and don’t give you blisters.

The best shoes don’t necessarily have to be barefoot footwear with a thin sole. What’s much more important is that the shoe is roomy and adaptive. If you don’t feel ready for barefoot, we recommend the Comfort line. It meets all the parameters of healthy shoes, but cushions your steps.

Tip: Read the article No more blisters! How to choose healthy shoes.

settings.title: How to get rid of a blister on your foot? What helps blisters from shoes?
settings.content:
If the blister is likely to burst on its own soon, you can pierce it. Careful: the needle must be sterile – boiled, for example. If it isn’t necessary, don’t pierce or peel the blister.

Has it already burst? Disinfect it and cover it with a plaster. At the pharmacy you’ll find special blister plasters that speed up healing.

Healthy shoes don’t cause blisters

Do your shoes give you blisters? Swap them quickly. Healthy shoes don’t cause blisters. A blister means the foot is being squeezed and can’t function naturally. We always make Ahinsa shoes from soft, pliable materials that won’t give you a blister.

If already when you put them on you think the shoe pinches and rubs, but that it will ease, pay attention. It’s likely that the shoe won’t ease — or not in the way you hope. Good shoes should fit you first time. They should be roomy and made from soft, adaptive materials.

Tip: Read the article No more blisters! How to choose healthy shoes. 

A doctor advises: “It’s important to choose shoes that really fit. In those, secondary pressure sores don’t form.”

MUDr. Martin Frolo

settings.title: How to straighten toes? How to straighten crooked toes?
settings.content:
Whether it’s bunions or hammer toes, the first step is the same: Swap your classic shoes for healthy, roomy footwear. Focus on making sure the toes can move naturally in the shoe. A roomy toe box and flexible materials will help you with that.

It’s non-anatomical shoes that often cause these problems. The toes are cramped in them, they can’t function naturally, and deformities occur.

Good news: You can straighten your toes

The next step will be exercise. The good news is that in most cases you can straighten your toes with exercise; surgery isn’t necessary except in exceptions.

How do you find out whether the toes can be straightened? Help yourself with your hand and try to straighten the toes. Does it work at least a little? If so, it means you can work the toes loose with exercise. 

Tip: Start exercising right away, even at home. Exercises from physiotherapist Lukáš Klimpera are in the e-book Happy Feet: The most common foot problems and exercises for them. It’s free – download it.

We also recommend a visit to a physiotherapist.

settings.title: How fast do feet grow?
settings.content:
The speed of growth is different for everyone. In general, though, with small children you can expect about 1.5 cm per year, with older ones around 1 cm. A preschooler can grow out of as many as 2 sizes in a year, a schoolchild out of 1 to 2 sizes. Don’t be alarmed if a child’s foot grows in a jump; that’s common.

Even adults shouldn’t rely on always the same size. Always try every new pair of shoes on properly. When you’re choosing online, measure your feet carefully and choose according to the manufacturer’s charts. That’s the only way you know the shoes will really fit.

Tip: Did you know you can exchange Ahinsa shoes free of charge? 

Children’s feet are developing. Give them room to do it.

Children’s feet are developing, so it’s important that shoes don’t restrict them. Check regularly whether the size still fits, so the foot doesn’t deform. Don’t forget the extra room. That’s the free space in front of the toes that lets the foot contract and stretch naturally.

Tip: As the foot grows, don’t forget bigger socks too. A good sock shouldn’t constrict or pinch the child, so look for ones that don’t contain elastane, don’t cut in around the ankle and don’t pull the toes together. A child needs freedom of movement for their development, so also watch out for any clothing that restricts or affects their movement.

settings.title: What is CF+ vegan leather made of?
settings.content:
CF+ is a material that has proven itself for us in shoes. It’s almost indestructible. It’s a special microfiber that the manufacturer treats so that it’s breathable and at the same time waterproof. It’s so durable that it’s also used to upholster yachts. And the composition? 90% polyamide and 10% polyurethane.

We’ve grown fond of it for many reasons. One of them is easy care. The microfiber doesn’t let dirt in, so one wipe with a damp cloth and the shoes look like new again.

Why don’t we use leather? CF+ is ethical and lasts longer

Why don’t we use animal leather? At Ahinsa shoes we honor the principle of non-violence, so leather isn’t the right path for us. Leather also requires maintenance, scuffs quickly, and takes time to mold to your foot.

CF+ microfiber has proven itself so well that for shoes made from it we guarantee they are the best shoes in the world. Really! If you find shoes with better properties, you get a 50% discount on Ahinsa shoes. You’ll find the details on the page.

Important: CF+ is not faux leather. It will last you for years. You won’t scratch it or scuff it. And you don’t have to look after it.

settings.title: Is artificial leather breathable?
settings.content:
It depends which faux leather you choose. Classic leatherette doesn’t breathe; it has no pores, so the feet sweat more in it and the shoes soon start to smell. By the way, have you read our tips against shoe odor? 

At Ahinsa shoes, though, we don’t use leatherette. We make our shoes by hand from CF+ microfiber, which lets air through to the foot and wicks moisture away from it. That’s why it keeps your feet dry.

We’ve grown fond of this microfiber for other reasons too:

  • It’s ethical. No animal suffered for it.
  • It doesn’t soak through. A little rain doesn’t bother it.
  • It’s easy to clean. One wipe with a damp cloth is enough.
  • It lasts for years. You won’t scratch it or scuff it. We’ve tried!
  • It wicks moisture out. From the inside it absorbs moisture and wicks it away from the feet.
Not only breathable. We guarantee the best shoes in the world

CF+ microfiber has proven itself so well that for shoes made from it we guarantee they are the best shoes in the world. Really! If you find shoes with better properties, you get a 50% discount on Ahinsa shoes. You’ll find the details on the page

Important: CF+ is not faux leather. It will last you for years. You won’t scratch it or scuff it. And you don’t have to look after it.

settings.title: What’s the difference between barefoot Ahinsa shoes and the Comfort line?
settings.content:
We’re glad you’re asking. It shows you care about healthy walking. We created these two lines because everyone likes a slightly different stride. You’ll notice the difference right when you land.

Our Barefoot line has a minimalist sole. Walking in them is similar to walking barefoot, so they’re ideal for you if you like to feel the world beneath you.

The Comfort line softens your steps thanks to a special flexible layer. In closed Comfort shoes we’ve also added a soft foam insole. That’s why these shoes are suitable for you if you want healthy, comfortable shoes but aren’t used to barefoot walking. 

Both the Barefoot line and Comfort line shoes meet this:

  • They were designed by physiotherapists.
  • In the wide toe box you have room for your toes to move.
  • Flexible materials and a bendable sole follow your movement.
  • They’re vegan and almost indestructible.
So which to choose? Comfort line or Barefoot line?

It depends how much of a fan of barefoot walking you are. Do you prefer extra comfort, or do you want to feel the world beneath you?

  • A fan of barefoot walking? Choose the Barefoot line. 
  • Just starting with barefoot walking? Choose the Comfort line. 
  • Want comfortable shoes and aren’t interested in barefoot? Choose the Comfort line.

Tip: Read the details on the page Barefoot or Comfort?

settings.title: What is the Ahinsa shoes sole made of?
settings.content:
On most shoes we use German soles made from a special high-grip compound. Thanks to it the shoes don’t slip, for example on rocks or a wet path. How do we know? We had the soles tested at an independent laboratory in Zlín.

Most often it’s the Lifoprene compound made from TPU. TPU is thermoplastic polyurethane – a flexible yet strong material that you won’t wear through anytime soon.

On selected models such as hiking sandals, snow boots or hiking sneakers or ankle boots for the trail we use proven Vibram soles.

Great soles make the best shoes. We guarantee it

Do you know how you can tell that our soles have really proven themselves? Thanks to them too we guarantee that Ahinsa shoes are the best shoes in the world. Really! If you find shoes with better properties, you get a 50% discount on Ahinsa shoes.

settings.title: Are Ahinsa shoes waterproof?
settings.content:
Most models unfortunately are not waterproof. We do make them from water-resistant microfiber, but water can seep in through the seams or the lace holes. Ordinary rain won’t soak you through, but a step into a puddle already might.

Our only water-resistant shoes so far are the Shuma Nature ankle boots, Shuma Winter boots, Irbis Snow snow boots and Hiker hiking boots. A gusseted tongue and a special membrane won’t let a single drop in, and at the same time they wick moisture away from the feet.

What can you do so the shoes don’t soak through? 

We recommend treating the shoes well before the first outing. If you didn’t get shoes made from CF+ microfiber, but for example from suede, nubuck, canvas, hemp, linen or denim, we recommend using a waterproofing spray.

This ecological waterproofing spray has worked well for us. It’s 100% vegan and biodegradable, and yet just as effective as chemical waterproofing sprays. What’s more, it will help you care for the shoes. It repels water and dirt, so you just wipe the shoes with a cloth and they’re like new again.

settings.title: How to sew barefoot shoes?
settings.content:
We don’t have a tutorial or a course for you yet, but we can show you how we do it. Read the article How are shoes sewn? A glance into a shoemaker’s workshop or watch the video.

We make the shoes in a family workshop in Croatia. You may be surprised how many steps and how much skill making barefoot shoes requires. And often physical strength, too! 

Watch the shape of the insole

If you do set out to sew your own shoes, pay attention above all to the shape of the insole. Our shoes are designed by physiotherapists so that they correspond to the natural shape and function of the foot. Only then do the shoes not affect your gait. 

And how will you recognize the right shoe shape? It certainly won’t have a narrow toe box, but a wide and roomy one. In a wide toe box the toes can move freely, they join in the push-off and shape the arch. 

Tip: You’ll find more inspiration in the article No more blisters! How to choose healthy shoes?

settings.title: When to give a child barefoot shoes?
settings.content:
Do you know what shoes children are born in? That’s right, none. Barefoot walking is the first thing they learn. Barefoot shoes therefore aren’t a transition to something new for them, but simply a continuation of what they already know. That’s why barefoot shoes are suitable even as first little shoes. But for as long as it’s possible, let the child walk and run barefoot – that’s the most natural thing for their development.

Don’t constrict a child’s foot; make sure the shoes are healthy

For children (and for us adults too), barefoot walking is the most natural movement. So definitely don’t lace a child into classic shoes. When the time comes for the first baby shoes, make sure the child can walk in them as freely as when barefoot.

The toe box should give the toes enough room for natural movement. The whole shoe should be made from a material that adapts to the movement of the foot, not the other way around.

Children’s shoes are often reinforced, hard and inflexible. That’s the exact opposite of what a developing child’s foot needs. A stiff, rigid shoe affects the development of the foot and the child’s gait and stores up trouble for the future.

If a child has worn classic shoes for a long time, switch to barefoot shoes slowly. Practice healthy walking on grass and on a soft surface before the child puts on barefoot shoes in the city as well.

Tip: Let the child run barefoot most of the time. There’s nothing healthier for the development of their feet.

settings.title: Are there barefoot shoes for running?
settings.content:
Yes, they exist, and they will even help you perform better! When running we push off mainly from the toes, so we need to free them. And that’s exactly what barefoot running shoes with a wide toe box can do. They’ll also help you activate the arch, which will cushion your landings. 

How to choose barefoot shoes for running?

When choosing barefoot shoes for running, make sure they’re not just ordinary sneakers with a thin sole. A wide toe box and flexible materials are important. The shoe should adapt perfectly to the movement of your foot and also to its shape.

Watch out for these properties:

  • A thick or stiff sole: It prevents natural movement and restricts you.
  • Too much cushioning: According to studies, it’s precisely because of cushioning that we land harder on the heel and injury is a risk. We don’t register the impact.
  • A narrow toe box: In most shoes the toes are squeezed together and can’t work. 

Tip: If you’re just starting with barefoot running, practice a healthy running style. The article [Guide] How to start running barefoot will help you with that.

And which shoes to choose? We recommend the breathable Chitra barefoot running shoes. We also have them for you in a trail version with a Vibram sole.

settings.title: Are barefoot shoes suitable for social events?
settings.content:
Yes, they do – you just need to choose an elegant model. Instead of pumps you can put on barefoot ballet flats. Instead of narrow men’s dress shoes, roomy barefoot dress shoes. 

You’ll notice that barefoot shoes are more and more common in company. You’ll see them at the theatre, at parties and at weddings. Remember: you look your best in company when you’re comfortable.

High heels destroy your knees, a study has shown

You probably know that classic formal shoes such as pumps aren’t comfortable. But did you know they seriously harm you? The consequences unfortunately appear sooner than you’d guess.

An interesting study recently came about in cooperation between the Department of Rehabilitation Medicine of the General University Hospital in Prague, the First Faculty of Medicine of Charles University, and Hacettepe University in Ankara. It examined women around 30 who regularly wear high-heeled shoes.

Besides back pain and foot deformities, the study showed that pumps destroy the cartilage of the knee. The changes were already visible in very young women, in whom ultrasound revealed a higher risk of osteoarthritis.

You no longer have to suffer for beauty. Choose shoes that don’t harm you instead.

Tip: Choosing shoes for a wedding? Read the article How to choose wedding shoes? A barefoot bride’s confession.

settings.title: Can I wear barefoot shoes in the city?
settings.content:
Yes, you can. With one condition: you are used to barefoot walking and you know how to land sensitively. 

City streets are a challenge for barefoot walking. We have to be much more aware of how we land and how we push off. That’s why we recommend first practicing barefoot walking on a softer surface, for example on a walk in the woods.

And what to wear until then? Definitely not classic constricting shoes. We recommend the Comfort line, which is as roomy and flexible as barefoot footwear, but softens your steps. 

Tip: Practice natural walking with the e-book Step by Step to Healthy Walking. It’s free.

The trouble with city walking: Hard heel landings

Why is a hard city surface actually a problem? Because years in classic non-anatomical shoes have taught us to walk unnaturally. We land hard on the heel and a huge impact is created that travels on through the body and puts the joints at risk.

In classic shoes you can’t walk any other way. They constrict your toes, so you’re left with no choice but to brake the landing with the heel. That’s why swap the shoes for anatomical ones and focus on the landing. It should be gentle, sensitive. 

And how do you know you’re walking healthily? Listen. If you’re stomping, it means you’re landing too hard.

Reading tip: Barefoot & the City: What You Need to Know.

settings.title: Can I wear barefoot shoes nonstop?
settings.content:
We recommend taking them off for bed. :) But otherwise yes, you can wear only barefoot footwear. Barefoot shoes are the shoes that don’t restrict your feet – that’s why they’re suitable for you all day long.

Reading tip: Barefoot & the City: What You Need to Know.

City streets are a more advanced challenge for barefoot walking

Just be careful in the city on a hard surface. Before you head into the city in barefoot shoes, practice healthy walking and a sensitive stride. 

Most adults have unlearned how to walk naturally. Classic shoes have taught them to land unnaturally on the heel. That’s hard to retrain and can be a problem especially in the city on a hard surface. When you land hard on the heel, a strong impact is created that travels through the body and puts the joints at risk. 

For the city we therefore recommend:

  1. Focus on a sensitive stride.
  2. Don’t rush; feel your steps.
  3. If you’re not sure, put on shoes from the Comfort line. They’re anatomical like barefoot shoes, but they cushion your steps thanks to a special flexible layer.

Tip: Practice natural walking with the e-book Step by Step to Healthy Walking. It’s free.

settings.title: Do barefoot shoes help muscles grow?
settings.content:
They can help, but they won’t grow your muscles for you on their own.

Barefoot shoes are first and foremost shoes that free your feet so you can use them naturally. The rest is up to you. When you learn to activate your feet, you’ll also engage muscles that doze off in ordinary shoes. Over time you may notice that it’s mainly the muscles of the sole that have strengthened. 

Tip: Learn to activate your feet with the e-book Step by Step to Healthy Walking. It’s free.

What effect do barefoot shoes have on your performance?

Do you know which shoes are best for running? None. The human foot evolved for running; it has its own mechanisms for push-off and for cushioning impact. That’s why it performs best when it’s free.

But running barefoot on Czech trails isn’t safe or comfortable. So put shoes on – but only in such a way that the foot can function as naturally as when barefoot and perform at its best. Put on barefoot shoes with a wide toe box and a pliable, flexible sole.

Reading tip: Barefoot running: People have been running for 2 million years. Only in recent years have we been ruining it with shoes.

settings.title: Why are barefoot shoes so expensive?
settings.content:
The main idea of barefoot shoes is healthy footwear. And for shoes to be healthy, they must be well made and produced from quality materials. That’s why they can’t have the same price tag as cheap mass-produced shoes. 

Ahinsa shoes: Handmade in the EU

Ahinsa shoes, for example, we make by hand. We sew them from materials that will last you for years and in which your feet feel good. During production they pass through many pairs of skilled hands. And those deserve a fair wage, don’t you think?

In return you get shoes that bring you joy for years. In the end you’ll find that you pay less per wear than with cheap, uncomfortable shoes.

By the way, do you know the term cost per wear? It’s the price per wear. When you buy cheap shoes, they soon give up on you. So each wear cost you more than if you’d invested in (almost) indestructible handmade shoes.

Tip: Curious how we make shoes? Read the article How are shoes sewn? A glance into a shoemaker’s workshop or watch the video.

settings.title: How long does a barefoot shoe sole last?
settings.content:
We can’t speak for other barefoot shoe makers, but at Ahinsa shoes we use durable soles made from German material. They’re thin, but they won’t wear through anytime soon. It depends on your walking style, but our shoes commonly last 5 years or more.

Indestructible, say customers and experts alike

And how do we know our soles last for years? We wear them ourselves – but above all, we had them tested. We sent Ahinsa shoes to an independent laboratory in Zlín. There they abrade the soles and simulate steps. After grinding that would already have destroyed ordinary shoes, our soles hadn’t given in one bit.

The lab results are confirmed by our customers, who have been wearing Ahinsa shoes for years. They often describe them as “indestructible”.

Thanks to the results from the lab and from customers, we guarantee that Ahinsa shoes are the best shoes in the world.

settings.title: Are barefoot shoes suitable for cycling?
settings.content:
Yes, they are. They can even help you perform better. They free your toes, so you can really push off with them. We recommend choosing ones that let enough air through to your feet and wick sweat away. We’ve had good results with Ahinsa shoes made from durable mesh.

PS: We’re already preparing special cycling barefoot shoes for you. Looking forward to them?

A thin sole? We have a solution

The only trouble you might have with barefoot shoes on a bike is with shoes that have a very thin sole. You feel the pedals through it, and that doesn’t suit everyone on a longer ride.

That’s why we’re preparing cycling barefoot shoes with a special sole that we’ve adapted specifically for long pedaling. 

Need healthy cycling shoes right now? Have a look at our Comfort line. A special flexible layer and our proven foam insole will make sure you hardly notice the pedals. You’ll still be comfortable: the wide toe box will free your toes and breathable materials will keep your feet dry.

settings.title: When are barefoot shoes not suitable?
settings.content:
Barefoot shoes aren’t suitable with certain specific diagnoses, such as various injury and post-operative conditions, neurological diseases (e.g. diabetic neuropathies) or acute injuries. We recommend talking it over with your doctor, who can assess whether they’re suitable for you. 

On the other hand, they can be a suitable part of treatment for a heel spur, bunions or flat feet. We wrote about that in the e-book Happy Feet: The most common foot problems and exercises for them.

Tip: Before you put on barefoot shoes for the first time, practice natural walking with the e-book Step by Step to Healthy Walking. It’s free.

Are barefoot shoes suitable for flat feet?

Yes, they are even often used precisely in the treatment of flat feet. Flat feet generally mean you don’t have active muscles that activate the arch. These muscles can’t work in classic shoes, so they weaken. When you give the foot room for natural walking in barefoot shoes, you can activate these muscles again and shape the arch naturally.

Always consult the specific condition and problems with a physiotherapist, though.

Reading tip: Read the article How can we cure flat feet? Shoes will help, but insoles won’t always do the trick.

settings.title: How long do barefoot shoes last?
settings.content:
We don’t want to speak for other makers, but Ahinsa shoes commonly serve customers for 5 years or more. The most durable are models made from CF+ microfiber, which you won’t scuff or scratch even if you try. Years and years of service also come from the durable German sole, which you won’t wear through anytime soon.

It always also depends on your walking style.

What we make barefoot shoes from so they last for years

We’ve already introduced you to CF+ microfiber. It’s an extremely durable material originally used to upholster yachts. That’s why it has to withstand just about anything. We’ve tried scratching it with a fork and leaving it in the sea (don’t ask why) – it survived everything. And yet it’s breathable and keeps the feet dry.

For soles we’ve grown fond of the German Lifo+ compound. It’s very flexible, so it adapts to your steps. It resists abrasion, so it takes millions and millions of steps before you even see any wear on it. 

How do we know? We had the soles tested at an independent laboratory in Zlín. Thanks to it too we know that Ahinsa shoes are the best shoes in the world. Really, we guarantee it!
